title: Accordion

data-title.description: Legacy fallback for `accordion-title`, read only when the canonical form is absent.

accordion-title.description: Marks a child as an accordion panel and supplies its header text. This is the canonical spelling; `data-accordion-title` is read as a fallback.

open.description: Start expanded. `expanded` is accepted as an equivalent. Bare attribute.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.

_scopeNote: Properties marked scope:"child" are read off each section, not off the host. collapse.js reads them via `child`/`sec`. They were scraped into this schema as host options by generate-behavior-schemas.mjs, which does not check the receiver (#861 category c) -- so every generated test set them on the host, where they can do nothing, and reported the behavior as broken.
